title: Autumn
summary: A warm miniature autumn world — steam, market lights, and campfire glow.
rules: Keep everything museum-quality and handcrafted. Warm amber lighting, lived-in wear, tilt-shift miniature scale. No modern tech, no harsh neon, no empty streets — always a few tiny figures living in the scene.
prompt: Museum-quality handcrafted miniature diorama in peak autumn. Hyperrealistic physical materials, warm cinematic lamps, golden foliage, cozy denseness. Every place feels like somewhere you’d stay the night.
